_rule: Rule 1 — read-only after bootstrap. A run may advance the pointer or raise a blocker; never re-order, redefine, or invent steps.

steps.title: scaffold + README + WALKTHROUGH + CI + frozen spec/plan + meta loader + tests
steps.gate: repo public, README>=200w, WALKTHROUGH>=300w, CI valid, tests green, no speculation

steps.title: select 5 OSS target projects with rich security-fix history; document selection criteria
steps.gate: data/answer_key/targets.md lists 5 projects x (language, fix-commit density, rationale)

steps.title: answer-key miner v1: git archaeology of fix commits -> data/answer_key/<project1>.json
phase gate: totals + spot-check 3 entries via GitHub API
src/run_scanner.py Semgrep wrapper; scan vulnerable snapshot of project 1
baseline scorer: precision/recall vs answer key with +/-5-line matching -> results/baseline.json
steps.gate: matching rule documented in code + docs

steps.title: LLM triage harness (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env, <=10 calls/run); pilot L0 on project 1
steps.gate: verdicts persisted with prompt hash; missing key = human gate

steps.title: extend triage to >=3 projects
steps.gate: >=3 projects, verdicts not uniform, cumulative spend <$5

steps.title: plot accuracy vs context level -> results/context_curve.png
steps.gate: curve plotted from persisted verdicts only

steps.title: final README <500w: quick-start, key finding, credits; reproducibility pass
publish: evidence sync to portal SPA + Ground Truth section 7
